stage.name: The Town of Taba
stage.description:
There's nothing necessarily prestigious about the battlefield, nor is there any fundamental reason for them to exist. Violence is not a reasonable thing, and sometimes, things happen simply because they happened.Condition:
DP will not naturally regenerate.

sarkaz_blademaster.name: Sarkaz Blademaster
sarkaz_blademaster.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary, more skilled than an ordinary Sarkaz Swordsman. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

sarkaz_swordsman.name: Sarkaz Swordsman
sarkaz_swordsman.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

light_armored_soldier.name: Light-Armored Soldier
light_armored_soldier.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Equipped with illegally obtained weapons and armor, they are better equipped and trained, and cannot be taken down with conventional strategies.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.flavourText: One of Reunion's engineers. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_2.name: Originium Slug α
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_2.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than a normal Originium Slug. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

wraith_leader.name: Wraith Leader
wraith_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's engineers. Due to being better trained and more heavily equipped, they are harder to neutralize in time, even if they have been detected. They utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

sarkaz_sentinel.name: Sarkaz Sentinel
sarkaz_sentinel.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

sarkaz_sentinel_leader.name: Sarkaz Sentinel Leader
sarkaz_sentinel_leader.flavourText: A seasoned Sarkaz mercenary who has been through many battles. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_crossbowman.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman
sarkaz_crossbowman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_grudgebearer.name: Sarkaz Grudgebearer
sarkaz_grudgebearer.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, allowing them to unleash Arts without relying on a staff. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

demolitionist.name: Demolitionist
demolitionist.flavourText: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.
abilities: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

sarkaz_bladeweaver.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver
sarkaz_bladeweaver.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

sarkaz_greatswordsman_leader.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman Leader
sarkaz_greatswordsman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Swordsman. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_caster.name: Sarkaz Caster
sarkaz_caster.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

sarkaz_lancer_leader.name: Sarkaz Lancer Leader
sarkaz_lancer_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

heavy_defender.name: Heavy Defender
heavy_defender.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

sarkaz_lancer.name: Sarkaz Lancer
sarkaz_lancer.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

sarkaz_worldcurser.name: Sarkaz Worldcurser
sarkaz_worldcurser.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz caster mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, and their accumulated resentment has crystallized into raw power. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

demolitionist_leader.name: Demolitionist Leader
demolitionist_leader.flavourText: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear, more aggressive than normal Demolitionists. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.
abilities: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver Leader
sarkaz_bladeweaver_leader.flavourText: An elite Sarkaz mercenary who has mastered the combination of swordsmanship and Arts. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman Leader
sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Sniper. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.
